scripts.typecheck: tsc --build && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/errors/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/check-ins/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/members/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/disclaimer-drafts/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/memes/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/push/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/squads/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/typed-text/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/admins/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ai-consent/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/nudges/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/disclaimer-styles/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/weekly-awards/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sports/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sport-ids/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/coach/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.db-types: sh -c 'kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern "public.(check_ins|check_in_squads|check_in_photos|check_in_reactions|check_in_comments|weekly_plans|weekly_plan_events|plan_templates|fuel_goals|fuel_goal_events|week_summary_words|week_summary_word_events)" --out-file packages/check-ins/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern "public.(profiles|profile_events)" --out-file packages/members/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern public.memes --out-file packages/memes/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern "public.(push_devices|push_settings|push_setting_events|daily_pushes|daily_push_settings|daily_push_setting_events)" --out-file packages/push/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern "public.(squads|squad_members|squad_membership_events|squad_events|squad_scene_picks)" --out-file packages/squads/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern "public.(disclaimer_draft_requests|disclaimer_draft_settings|disclaimer_draft_setting_events|disclaimer_dice|disclaimer_dice_events)" --out-file packages/disclaimer-drafts/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern "public.(admins|admin_actions)" --out-file packages/admins/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern "public.(weekly_awards|weekly_award_winners|weekly_award_settings|weekly_award_setting_events)" --out-file packages/weekly-awards/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern public.ai_consents --out-file packages/ai-consent/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern public.nudges --out-file packages/nudges/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern "public.(sport_categories|sports|sport_picks)" --out-file packages/sports/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@" && kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --date-parser string --include-pattern "public.(coach_settings|coach_setting_events|coaches|coach_catalog_events|coach_wakes|coach_files|coach_notes|coach_usage|squad_coaches|squad_coach_events)" --out-file packages/coach/src/adapters/tables.ts "$@"' db-types
